# Examples

## Contracts

Complete environments in [`contracts/`](contracts/). Each one checks clean and runs, and a test covers it: the
top-level ones reproduce a golden run (`tests/test_examples.py`). A folder named like a contract
(`exchange_flagship/`) holds that contract's imports and data. The table is generated from each contract's
`name` and `description` by `make docs`.

<!-- contracts table: generated by scripts/build_docs_reference.py -->
| Contract | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`auction_house.json`](contracts/auction_house.json) | **Auction house.** Collectors with private valuations bid for three identical vases. |
| [`auto_parts_store.json`](contracts/auto_parts_store.json) | **Auto parts store: demand patterns and reorder policies.** A parts store's weekly trade in 12 SKUs (brake pads, batteries and wiper blades for two makes, each in a premium and a value tier), on the economy demand and replenishment modes. |
| [`beer_game.json`](contracts/beer_game.json) | **Beer distribution game (native supply chain).** The beer game rebuilt on the economy inventory and supply_chain modes: four tiers (retailer, wholesaler, distributor, factory), each seeing only its own position and ordering from the tier above. |
| [`blackjack.json`](contracts/blackjack.json) | **Blackjack.** Three players against a dealer with a fixed house policy: bets, hit, stand, double down, 3:2 blackjacks, and a dealer who hits or stands on soft 17. |
| [`boltzmann_wealth.json`](contracts/boltzmann_wealth.json) | **Boltzmann wealth.** Everyone starts with one coin. Each step, in random order, every person with a coin gives one to a person picked at random. |
| [`checkers.json`](contracts/checkers.json) | **Checkers (native).** English draughts for two players on an 8x8 board, played natively by the board mechanism. |
| [`chess.json`](contracts/chess.json) | **Chess.** Full legal chess for two players, played natively by the board mechanism. |
| [`civil_trial.json`](contracts/civil_trial.json) | **Civil Trial Engine.** A civil jury trial on the procedure mechanism: openings, direct examination with exhibits, objections and rulings, cross-examination, closings, a sealed jury room where each juror's speech pulls the others' leanings toward where it points (what a bound judge host ('judge') reads in its words; without one, the speaker's own leaning, not what is said), secret ballots and a judgment. |
| [`climate_club.json`](contracts/climate_club.json) | **Climate club negotiation 2025-2055.** Six major economies negotiate emission cuts over six five-year periods under a continuous CO2-temperature model, with an optional climate club (common carbon price, border tariffs on non-members). |
| [`coffee_market.json`](contracts/coffee_market.json) | **Market Engine.** A month in a city's coffee market: sampled households choose daily whether to buy (against making coffee at home) and where; cafés (an input) reprice weekly toward more profit, and may promote and sell loyalty subscriptions. |
| [`color_match.json`](contracts/color_match.json) | **Color Match.** An UNO-like shedding game for four: match the top card's color or number, Draw Two and Wild cards, and a draw pile refilled by reshuffling the discards. |
| [`connect_four.json`](contracts/connect_four.json) | **Connect Four (native).** Classic Connect Four on a 6-row, 7-column board, played natively by the board mechanism. |
| [`contact_centre.json`](contracts/contact_centre.json) | **Northline contact centre: staffing a day of calls.** One day (08:00-20:00, half-hours) at a broadband provider's contact centre, played call by call by an operations queue. |
| [`corner_shop_town.json`](contracts/corner_shop_town.json) | **Corner shop town.** A small town economy: households live on a monthly allowance that resets, buy food at two shops with limited stock and daily capacity, may join a café's coffee subscription (free trial, monthly renewals) and book tables at a bistro with a waitlist. |
| [`court_exhibits.json`](contracts/court_exhibits.json) | **Harbor Fabrication v. Meridian Logistics (exhibits).** A bench trial carried on real evidence files. The signed agreement (a PDF) is in every brief; each side first sees only its own exhibits — an inspection report, weld and loading-dock photos — which stay sealed from the other side and the judge until trial opens, when every exhibit counsel offered is revealed to the judge and both attorneys. |
| [`crafting_village.json`](contracts/crafting_village.json) | **Crafting village.** Villagers gather wood, grain and ore, craft flour, bread, iron and pickaxes at the workshop with skills that grow with practice, eat to stay healthy, and trade with the village store at posted prices. |
| [`diplomacy.json`](contracts/diplomacy.json) | **Five Crowns.** A Diplomacy-style game of alliances and betrayal: five nations, twenty provinces, simultaneous orders. |
| [`dungeon_skirmish.json`](contracts/dungeon_skirmish.json) | **Dungeon skirmish.** Three heroes and three monsters fight on a 6x6 dungeon floor with forest cover, a swamp, lava and a wall: poison, stuns and shields, cooldowns and charges, channeled fireballs, initiative by speed, and victory to the last team standing or the healthier team when time runs out. |
| [`epidemic_shocks.json`](contracts/epidemic_shocks.json) | **Town epidemic under uncertainty.** The town epidemic with an uncertain transmission rate sampled every run, compliance that drifts (fatigue under lockdown, slow recovery of trust afterwards), recurring superspreader events and a hospital alarm that can force a lockdown. |
| [`evidence_hearing.json`](contracts/evidence_hearing.json) | **Evidence hearing.** Counsel offer exhibits; opposing counsel may object and the judge rules. |
| [`exchange_flagship.json`](contracts/exchange_flagship.json) | **Exchange (flagship).** A stock exchange session calibrated to a seed history: one instrument on a continuous price-time limit order book with maker/taker fees, a market-order collar, short selling capped by equity and a circuit breaker on the bar's open, traded pass by pass by a calibrated crowd of market makers, momentum, mean-reversion, fundamental, noise and passive traders, with scheduled news that moves a hidden fundamental and market sentiment (by default a guidance cut at bar 30 knocks 8% off it), online volume and volatility controllers, stop-loss liquidations, a few trader seats (4 by default) that participants fill and that decide between bars, and a realism score against the seed tape. |
| [`exchange_native.json`](contracts/exchange_native.json) | **Single-stock exchange (native order book).** The order_book_exchange scenario on the native market mechanism's order_book mode: a continuous limit order book with price-time priority, partial fills, maker/taker fees, a market-order collar, order expiry, a fundamental news shock and a circuit breaker, traded by coded market makers, momentum traders and fundamentalists (and optional agent seats). |
| [`farmers_market.json`](contracts/farmers_market.json) | **Farmers market.** Three farmers post prices for apples, pears and honey; a dozen shoppers browse a ranked shelf, buy within a daily stall capacity, haggle where a farmer is open to offers, and rate what they bought. |
| [`forecast_council.json`](contracts/forecast_council.json) | **Rate Decision Forecasting Council.** A panel of experts (inputs.panel; seven by default) forecasts a yes/no question (inputs.question; by default whether the central bank cuts rates at its next meeting): sealed initial ballot, open deliberation until everyone is ready, sealed final ballot. |
| [`forest_fire.json`](contracts/forest_fire.json) | **Forest fire.** Trees fill a grid at some density; the left column is set alight. |
| [`game_of_life.json`](contracts/game_of_life.json) | **Game of Life.** Conway's cellular automaton on a wrapping grid: a live cell with two or three live neighbours survives, a dead cell with exactly three comes alive, every other cell is dead next generation. |
| [`go_9x9.json`](contracts/go_9x9.json) | **Go 9x9.** Go on a 9x9 board with area scoring and komi, played natively by the board mechanism. |
| [`hangman_duel.json`](contracts/hangman_duel.json) | **Hangman duel.** Two players each reveal the other's secret word letter by letter before running out of strikes, best of three games. |
| [`hearts.json`](contracts/hearts.json) | **Hearts.** Four-player Hearts: follow suit, hearts cannot be led until broken, every heart costs a point and the queen of spades thirteen; shooting the moon included. |
| [`holdem_lite.json`](contracts/holdem_lite.json) | **Hold'em Lite.** A four-seat Texas Hold'em-lite table: two hole cards, three community cards, one betting round, simplified showdown. |
| [`hopscotch_race.json`](contracts/hopscotch_race.json) | **Hopscotch race.** Two friends race along a hopscotch court. A turn is up to two hops that land together; a turn ending on a stone is undone and played again. |
| [`kuhn_poker.json`](contracts/kuhn_poker.json) | **Kuhn poker.** The smallest poker: three cards, one each, one bet. Its equilibrium value for the first player is -1/18, so solvers can check themselves against it (fg_env.rl.game). |
| [`labor_negotiation.json`](contracts/labor_negotiation.json) | **Labor contract negotiation.** A union and a firm bargain over wages, benefits and a job guarantee with alternating offers, strikes and lockouts, a mediator from round 7, and a hard deadline. |
| [`lemonade_stand.json`](contracts/lemonade_stand.json) | **Lemonade stand.** Two stands set a price every hour at the same time; 40 customers split between them in proportion to how cheap each is. |
| [`misinformation.json`](contracts/misinformation.json) | **Misinformation on a follower network.** 200 accounts on a follower graph share, like and report posts about breaking stories, some of them false. |
| [`order_book_exchange.json`](contracts/order_book_exchange.json) | **Single-stock exchange.** A continuous limit order book for one stock with price-time priority, partial fills, per-side trading fees, a fundamental news shock and a circuit breaker. |
| [`othello.json`](contracts/othello.json) | **Othello.** Othello (Reversi) on an 8x8 board, played natively by the board mechanism. |
| [`outbreak_network.json`](contracts/outbreak_network.json) | **Outbreak on a contact network.** A town of residents whose viral load and immunity evolve continuously and noisily inside each person, spread along a contact network whose links carry a setting and a closeness, with newcomers wired in by lifecycle hooks, daily weather from a data feed, and health advisories that reach the town a day late and not always. |
| [`parliament_bill.json`](contracts/parliament_bill.json) | **The Clean Rivers Bill.** A bill passes through first, second and third readings with a committee stage between; each reading ends in a division. |
| [`phone_reseller.json`](contracts/phone_reseller.json) | **Used-iPhone reseller: graded stock, two channels and launches.** A bulk reseller of used iPhones (four models, four grades each) on the economy demand and replenishment modes. |
| [`prediction_market.json`](contracts/prediction_market.json) | **Election forecast market.** Forecasters with private hunches trade shares in three candidates on an LMSR prediction market. |
| [`product_listing.json`](contracts/product_listing.json) | **Product listings.** A small marketplace whose listings carry product photos. The catalogue is a CSV with an image column; buyers see each in-stock listing with its photo and receive the photo of what they bought, and the seller may relist a product with a new photo it submits (an image file checked for type and size). |
| [`ride_hailing.json`](contracts/ride_hailing.json) | **Ride-hailing city.** Thirty drivers serve ride requests on a 10x10 city grid in 5-minute steps. |
| [`schelling.json`](contracts/schelling.json) | **Schelling segregation.** Households of two groups live on a wrapping grid, one per cell. |
| [`social_network.json`](contracts/social_network.json) | **Rumor on a social network.** 150 accounts on a follower network post, like and repost from ranked feeds while a false rumor about a dam spreads by independent cascade along follows. |
| [`sudoku_relay.json`](contracts/sudoku_relay.json) | **Sudoku relay.** Two solvers take turns filling a sudoku generated from the run's seed with exactly one solution; a right digit scores a point, a wrong one costs a point. |
| [`sugarscape_lite.json`](contracts/sugarscape_lite.json) | **Sugarscape (lite).** Sugarscape with sugar only: sugar grows back to each cell's capacity on two peaks. |
| [`texas_holdem.json`](contracts/texas_holdem.json) | **Texas Hold'em.** No-limit Texas Hold'em for 4 to 6 players: blinds, preflop, flop, turn and river betting, all-in side pots and an exact showdown. |
| [`town_epidemic.json`](contracts/town_epidemic.json) | **Town epidemic.** A 300-resident town on a small-world contact network faces a respiratory outbreak. |
| [`town_hall.json`](contracts/town_hall.json) | **Town hall on the skate park.** Residents debate whether the town should build a skate park. |
| [`trade_negotiation.json`](contracts/trade_negotiation.json) | **Steel trade negotiation.** Two countries negotiate a steel trade deal over three issues (price, yearly quota, years) before a deadline. |
| [`weekly_inventory.json`](contracts/weekly_inventory.json) | **Weekly inventory decision.** One retailer orders stock each week before a fixed demand arrives, tracking units sold, lost sales and cash. |
| [`werewolf.json`](contracts/werewolf.json) | **Werewolf (roles mechanism).** Social deduction among the players (nine by default): the werewolves (two by default), one seer, one doctor and villagers for the rest, dealt and hidden by the roles mechanism, with the day vote as a ballot. |
| [`wolf_sheep.json`](contracts/wolf_sheep.json) | **Wolf-sheep predation.** Sheep graze grass that regrows after a delay; wolves eat sheep. |
| [`wordle_duel.json`](contracts/wordle_duel.json) | **Wordle duel.** Two players race to crack each other's secret five-letter word with Wordle feedback, best of three games. |
| [`business_acceptance/garden_supply_bundles.json`](contracts/business_acceptance/garden_supply_bundles.json) | **Garden supply: weather-sensitive products and constrained starter bundles.** A round-based business acceptance scenario; all behavioral parameters are explicit assumptions, not fitted market estimates. |
| [`business_acceptance/refurbished_electronics.json`](contracts/business_acceptance/refurbished_electronics.json) | **Refurbished electronics: grades, returns and supply disruption.** A round-based business acceptance scenario; all behavioral parameters are explicit assumptions, not fitted market estimates. |
| [`business_acceptance/stadium_food_market.json`](contracts/business_acceptance/stadium_food_market.json) | **Stadium food market: weather, rivalry and daily spoilage.** A round-based business acceptance scenario; all behavioral parameters are explicit assumptions, not fitted market estimates. |
| [`business_composition/campaign_fulfillment.json`](contracts/business_composition/campaign_fulfillment.json) | **Campaign audiences, customer decisions and fulfillment.** Acceptance composition, not a calibrated forecast. Two creators have overlapping audiences. |
| [`business_composition/regional_rollouts.json`](contracts/business_composition/regional_rollouts.json) | **Regional rollouts sharing funding and stock.** Two regional rollouts, each a procedure, share one funding pot and one warehouse: a region launches once its managers approve and the money and stock are there. |
| [`games/biased_pennies.json`](contracts/games/biased_pennies.json) | **Biased pennies.** A zero-sum 2x2 matrix game with a lopsided payoff. Its unique equilibrium has both players show heads with probability 1/3; the row player's value is 1/3. |
| [`games/chicken.json`](contracts/games/chicken.json) | **Chicken.** The one-shot anti-coordination game. The pure equilibria have exactly one player go straight; the mixed equilibrium goes straight with probability 1/10. |
| [`games/first_price_auction.json`](contracts/games/first_price_auction.json) | **First-price sealed-bid auction.** Two bidders with private values drawn uniformly from 1 to `values` bid sealed whole numbers at once; the highest bid wins and pays its bid, ties split the item. |
| [`games/goofspiel.json`](contracts/games/goofspiel.json) | **Goofspiel.** Imperfect-information Goofspiel: sealed simultaneous bids for prize cards turned up in a random order; players learn who won each prize but never the other bid. |
| [`games/kuhn_poker.json`](contracts/games/kuhn_poker.json) | **Kuhn poker.** The smallest poker as a game with explicit chance nodes: three cards, one each, ante 1, pass or bet. |
| [`games/leduc_poker.json`](contracts/games/leduc_poker.json) | **Leduc poker.** Two-player Leduc hold'em: six cards (two each of J, Q, K), ante 1, two betting rounds with raises of 2 and then 4 (at most two a round), one public card. |
| [`games/liars_dice.json`](contracts/games/liars_dice.json) | **Liar's dice.** Two players, one hidden die each. Players raise bids on how many dice show a face; the next player may call the bid a lie instead. |
| [`games/matching_pennies.json`](contracts/games/matching_pennies.json) | **Matching pennies.** The one-shot zero-sum game: both show a coin at once and the matcher wins when they match. |
| [`games/nim.json`](contracts/games/nim.json) | **Nim.** Two players take 1 to 3 stones from one heap in turn; whoever takes the last stone wins. |
| [`games/pig.json`](contracts/games/pig.json) | **Pig.** The dice race with a roll-or-bank decision after every roll: explicit chance nodes, several decisions per turn, perfect information. |
| [`games/prisoners_dilemma.json`](contracts/games/prisoners_dilemma.json) | **Prisoner's dilemma.** The one-shot general-sum matrix game (T=5, R=3, P=1, S=0). Defecting strictly dominates, so the only equilibrium is mutual defection (1, 1). |
| [`games/rock_paper_scissors.json`](contracts/games/rock_paper_scissors.json) | **Rock paper scissors.** The one-shot zero-sum matrix game. Its unique equilibrium plays each move with probability 1/3; the game's value is 0. |
| [`games/stag_hunt.json`](contracts/games/stag_hunt.json) | **Stag hunt.** The one-shot coordination game. Both pure profiles (stag, stag) and (hare, hare) are equilibria; the mixed equilibrium hunts stag with probability 3/4. |
| [`games/tic_tac_toe.json`](contracts/games/tic_tac_toe.json) | **Tic-tac-toe.** Noughts and crosses on a 3x3 board written in plain rules: alternating marks, three in a row wins, a full board draws. |
| [`host/debate_judged.json`](contracts/host/debate_judged.json) | **Judged debate.** Two debaters give three speeches each; an impartial rubric judge scores every speech and the higher total wins. |
| [`host/research_council.json`](contracts/host/research_council.json) | **Research council.** A panel of forecasters researches a question with a host search tool, remembers what it found, discusses on a board and submits probability forecasts each round. |
| [`host/tavern_gm.json`](contracts/host/tavern_gm.json) | **Tavern with a game master.** Adventurers in a tavern describe what they try in their own words; a game master resolves each attempt, but only within the contract's allow-list. |
<!-- end contracts table -->

From this folder (`cd examples`):

```bash
fg-env check contracts/werewolf.json
fg-env preview contracts/werewolf.json p1
fg-env run contracts/werewolf.json --seed 3 --events
fg-env experiment contracts/town_epidemic.json --runs 5
```

## Studies

Scripts that take a contract further with `fg_env.analysis`: regenerate a history, fit a model to it, compare
policies, optimise a decision and validate a forecast.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `auto_parts_history.py`, `auto_parts_policies.py` | The auto-parts store: demand patterns fitted from sales, reorder policies compared and optimised per category |
| `contact_centre_history.py`, `contact_centre_plan.py` | The contact centre: a model estimated from half-hourly history, the cheapest staffing that meets the service level |
| `phone_reseller_study.py` | The used-iPhone reseller: channels compared, a new-model launch forked mid-run, the forecast validated |
